news.title: Acer releases new 18-inch gaming laptop with 240 Hz display and RTX 5080 GPU
news.description: Acer has released a new 18-inch gaming laptop featuring Intel's Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor. Also equipped with a 240 Hz IPS and 500-nit display, the latest Predator Helios Neo 18 leverages Nvidia's GeForce RTX 5080 laptop GPU and 32 GB of RAM, too.
